visual_review: All seven final rendered pages inspected. Readable text, no overlap or clipping, corrected short task labels, consistent headers and footers, original card retained on a landscape appendix page.
calculation_review: All 230 task scores checked in extracted PDF text. Public checks independently reproduce panel means, all total scores, ten group means and standard errors, task coverage, selected-call bindings and cost totals.
punctuation_review: No em or en dash characters in extracted PDF text, benchmark index, page stylesheet, current README, agent instructions or public evidence bundle. HTML entities are decoded before page checks.
sources: Public measurement record at commit 9bc9a25cf7d26d75ed5b8f5fa9ccd472bf093c8d, in assets/data/swe-v4-astra-fable51.
publication_scope: 230 run records, 1380 selected ratings, 1386 reviewer-call dispositions, costs, general review protocols and provenance. Hidden task material, patches, raw trajectories, rationales and host identifiers are withheld.
limitations: Arithmetic and hash checks are not independent proof of no contamination, prohibited access or judge bias. No benchmark reruns or grading changes were performed. Historical archived PDFs were not rewritten.
